doc.name: G — 30s fashion transformation set in a modern office, tender in tone, a cityscape as the protagonist, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: fashion transformation set in a modern office, tender in tone
Hero: a cityscape as the protagonist
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the fashion transformation set in a modern office, tender in tone form, built around a cityscape as the protagonist.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. The hero prop introduced in Act 1 must be physically present in Acts 2 and 3.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance in Act 1 against a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance in Act 3 — while holding the near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second fashion transformation set in a modern office, tender in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same cityscape as the protagonist.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a vertigo/dolly-zoom counter-move holding the subject size constant, shot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/5.6, framed with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation; grade as a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second fashion transformation set in a modern office, tender in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same cityscape as the protagonist.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a dolly-out that opens the frame into its environment, shot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/1.8, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with flickering firelight as the only motivated source; grade as Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second fashion transformation set in a modern office, tender in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same cityscape as the protagonist.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a whip pan that resolves onto the subject, shot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/1.4, framed with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a projected gobo throwing a broken pattern across the background; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

config.negative_prompt: blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows
